name: @nanobpm/agentic-vocab
description: Vocab resolver + core vocabulary for the Nano agentic protocol (ADR 0056, S3): the capability-declaration handshake (REGISTER {capability} -> SERVE [leaf tokens]), the opinionated core vocabulary (planning.*/qa.*/implementation.*/ci.*/decide + seats), author-extension merge in the same S0 schema, and the diversity SLO (family(#red) != family(#blue), warn-default with strict opt-in per role). Built on @nanobpm/agentic-protocol.
